# VAST G1-J5 (websynth)

> A browser-based virtual-analog synthesizer studio: 8-voice poly synth with a
> ladder filter, a 4-track 16-step note sequencer, an 8-track drum machine, an
> 8-slot sampler, a parameter-automation (motion) sequencer, per-bar arrangement
> chains, live DJ FX, and WAV/MP3 audio export.
> Runs entirely client-side (vanilla TypeScript + Web Audio, no backend).

AI agents can author songs for this synth as a single JSON file, which the
user imports via Song panel -> Import (or opens via a share link).

## Song formats

Two JSON formats are accepted on import:

- `websynth-song-author` (v1) — the compact AUTHORING dialect, recommended for
  AI output (~40-80 lines). Melody banks are positional note lists ("A2",
  "C#4", null = rest, C4 = 60), drums/sampler are hit lists keyed by track
  name (kick, snare, chat, ohat, ltom, mtom, htom, clap / s1..s8), and song
  structure is a chain string like "AABA". Input-only: the app expands it to
  the canonical format on import.
  Schema: /schema/websynth-song-author.schema.json
- `websynth-song` (v6) — the canonical full format the app exports. Requires
  literal grids: seqBanks[4][16], drumBanks[4][8][16], optional
  samplerBanks[4][8][16] and motionBanks[4][16] (XY param automation).
  Older versions still load: every addition is optional. v6 adds seqTracks
  (note-sequencer tracks 2-4) and v5 motionTracks (motion's two extra
  single-parameter tracks).
  Schema: /schema/websynth-song.schema.json

Dimensions: 4 banks (A/B/C/D) per machine; 16 sixteenth-note steps per bar;
4 note-sequencer tracks per bank (track 1 in seqBanks, tracks 2-4 in the
optional seqTracks[bank][track], which is indexed by the real track number so
index 0 is always null); 8 drum tracks (0=Kick 1=Snare 2=C.Hat 3=O.Hat 4=L.Tom
5=M.Tom 6=H.Tom 7=Clap); 8 sampler slots. Per-step settings: velocity/gate/prob
0..1, ratchet 1..4, tie boolean. `filter.cutoff` is a MIDI note number, not Hz.
The motion sequencer (dialect key `motion`) steps/interpolates the XY Pad's two
assigned params through per-step anchors {step, x, y} in normalized 0..1, plus
two optional single-parameter tracks per bank (motionTracks) that each name
their own parameter id and carry 16 levels.

## The live parameter table

Synth parameters (ids, ranges, defaults, discrete value maps) are generated
from the running app and are NOT duplicated here — open the app's Song panel
-> "✨ AI Prompt" for the complete, always-current authoring prompt including
the PARAMS table.

## For developers

- The repository's `specs/` folder is the architectural source of truth
  (specs/features/song-authoring-dialect.md documents the author dialect).
- An MCP server for song authoring/validation ships in the repo under
  `scripts/mcp/` (see the README).
